form.title: Treasury balance exposed through the balance API without a valid key
form.impact: The treasury account balance was returned to an unknown external caller.
form.details: An external caller read the treasury settlement account (ACC-9000) balance through the balance API several times. The caller never signed in, and the treasury reconciliation job is the only client that holds a key for that account. The job's key has not been rotated or shared. We don't know how the caller was authorised.

expected_cause: balance.php compares the api_key with != (loose compare); the treasury key is an 0e magic hash, so key=0 equals it. Use hash_equals and a random key.
